runs.t: Factory Method delegates creation of a product to subclasses or specialized creators; Abstract Factory creates related families of products through a common contract. Both isolate callers from concrete construction details.

Choose Factory Method when one creation step varies and Abstract Factory when compatible groups of objects must change together. In functional languages, a factory function may express the same intent without inheritance.
A file converter chooses a PDF or image renderer by output type. A theme system may construct a consistent set of button, dialog and menu implementations for different platforms.
Factories that merely call a constructor add little value. Do not confuse Abstract Factory with generic DI containers, and ensure product families actually need consistency guarantees.
